messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout start: release/v3.1 -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-15T18:02:25Z. Automated health checks running.
incident-bot: Alert: /generate error rate increased to 2.8% (baseline 0.12%). Auto-rollback attempted and returned nonzero code (2). Creating incident thread. Paging @alex (oncall). Severity: P1.
alex (oncall): Ack — I'm oncall. Paging runtime and release leads. @priya, @mike can you jump in?
priya (releases): I'm here. This canary included the new q4 quantization+prefetch change behind ff:new_prefetch_model.
mike (eng-runtime): Seeing GPU memory thrashing on canary pods: OOM kill events on node g-rcu-3. Latency tail > 5s and some 502s. Logs attached below.
priya (releases): Noted. Auto-rollback failed; deploy-bot shows "rollback job crashed: couldn't detach KV cache".
dan (platform): I can try to drain traffic off the canary pool manually while we investigate. Recommend draining before full revert if rollback is flaky.
sara (cs): Heads-up: monitoring is flagging increased error rates for a subset of customers (non-prod test orgs first). No inbound customer support tickets yet. Will notify CS SRE channel. :eyes:
alex (oncall): Plan: 1) drain canary traffic to 0% 2) if drain succeeds, re-evaluate option to toggle ff:new_prefetch_model off 3) if drain or flag flip fails, manual rollback to v3.0. Priya, can you run the flag toggle? Mike/dan, please prepare rollback command.
priya (releases): Toggling flag off now via LaunchDarkly API.
priya (releases): ```bash
curl -X PATCH 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $LD_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2/flags/prod/new_prefetch_model 
  -d '{"patch": [{"op":"replace","path":"/environments/production/on","value":false}]}'
```
priya (releases): Flag flip returned 200. Requesting metric stabilization window of 60s.
mike (eng-runtime): Initiating drain for canary pool 'canary-2026-03-15' -> reduce to 0% using router command.
mike (eng-runtime): ```
redwoodctl traffic set --pool canary-2026-03-15 --percent 0 --grace-period 30s
```
mike (eng-runtime): Drain issued. Router reports in-progress, several requests still pinned due to KV caches.
dan (platform): KV cache pinning is preventing fast drain. I can evict caches from canary nodes manually. Running eviction script.
dan (platform): ```
ssh ops@g-rcu-3 'sudo systemctl stop redwood-kv && rm -rf /var/lib/redwood/kv/tmp && systemctl start redwood-kv'
```
dan (platform): Eviction ran on g-rcu-3 and g-rcu-4. Drain now shows 0% and no active sessions.
incident-bot: Auto-rollback job now re-triggered as manual fallback: rollback target v3.0 (sha:abc123). Rolling back canary pool.
deploy-bot: Manual rollback command executed by alex: ``redwood deploy rollback --pool canary-2026-03-15 --to sha:abc123 --force``. Rollback started at 2026-03-15T18:08:47Z.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: canary reverted to v3.0. Smoke checks: /health OK, /generate errors back to 0.11% over 2m window, median latency normal.
alex (oncall): Running smoke tests: 10 sample requests, token outputs look sane, no hallucinations in smoke prompts.
sara (cs): Notified CS and enterprise customers possibly impacted in the window (12:02-18:09 UTC). Templates sent. No escalations so far.
priya (releases): Marking release/v3.1 paused. I'll open a rollback postmortem and capture root cause telemetry (GPU memory pattern + KV cache retention + new prefetch behavior). Assigning to releases + eng-runtime.
mike (eng-runtime): Action items: reproduce OOM locally with q4 quantization + prefetch enabled, add canary preflight to fail if OOMs detected, harden KV detach in rollback path.
dan (platform): I'll add an emergency router switch that can force-evict pinned sessions in future and add a canary drain metric to alert earlier.
alex (oncall): Closing loop: incident status -> mitigated. I'll hand to priya for postmortem and to sara for customer comms follow-up. If anything else pops, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2026-03-15T18:14:59Z. Severity remains P1, will transition to postmortem.
priya (releases): I'll create a short postmortem doc and ping for a 1h root-cause sync.
sara (cs): Thanks all — monitoring and CS watch continuing for 24h.
deploy-bot: Closing deploy incident: canary rollback complete.
